title: A one-to-one relationship filters from the first table to the second
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Categories", CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( ProductCategory ), Product[Color] = "Green" ) )

source.quote: For one-to-one relationships, the cross filter direction is always from both tables
source.supports: one-to-one relationships always filter from both tables

source.quote: The relationship filters in both directions, which is always the case for one-to-one relationships

derivation: Color Green is SKU CL-01, which is one ProductCategory row (Clothing).
